_comment: Paperclip DIRECT adapter config: routes an agent straight through the local llm-provider's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (grok + local models), NO hermes. A Paperclip agent using adapterType 'gateway_openai' with this adapterConfig loads gateway-adapter/index.mjs, whose execute(ctx) POSTs to /v1/chat/completions and streams the reply via ctx.onLog. On this Mac the gateway trusts loopback, so no apiKey is needed; set apiKey/apiKeyFile only for remote access.
